recipe.name: Kokum Kick
recipe.description: A vibrant highball pairing crisp tequila blanco with tangy, fruity kokum and a distinct savory, salty undertone.
steps: Combine Camino Blanco, house-made kokum cordial, and a pinch of sea salt in a shaker filled with ice.
Shake briefly to chill and blend the flavors.
Strain into a highball glass packed with fresh ice cubes.
Top up with chilled soda and stir gently once to combine without losing effervescence.
recipe.garnish: Salt rim or dehydrated citrus wheel
recipe.serving: Serve immediately with a bar straw.
